sc6-lowest.title: Where are the limits lowest?
sc6-lowest.prompt: Find a frequency where the general-public limit is at its lowest.
sc6-lowest.success: 48 to 300 MHz: the body absorbs RF most here, so the limits are lowest.

sc6-environment.title: Controlled environments
sc6-environment.prompt: Switch to a controlled environment and compare the limit.
sc6-environment.success: Higher limits where people know about the exposure; lower ones for the general public.
